content: विसंवद् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To be inconsistent, be at variance; कमलानां मनोहराणामपि रूपाद्विसंवदति शीलम् <ls>Mu. 1. 19</ls>; शकटदासस्तु मित्रमिति विसंवदन्त्यक्षराणि <ls>Mu. 5</ls>. .²2 To break oneʼs word or promise. .²3 To disappoint, deceive. .²4 To fail. .²5 To assert falsely. .²6 To contradict. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To make inconsistent. .²2 To disappoint, to cause to fail; रमणीयोऽवधिर्विधिना विसंवादितः <ls>Ś. 6</ls>. .²3 To fail to prove.
